_comment: Detector check of the full comparison: identical to config_full.json except that every detection uses the untuned 'opencv_default' preset (OpenCV's default DetectorParameters, plus the board's border width and error correction, which describe the printed target and were set before the sweep) instead of 'water_final', which the sweep chose by running calibrateCamera. Its own calibrations and outputs, so nothing of config_full.json is touched. Run: src/venv/bin/python src/experiments/reproduce.py compensation --config src/experiments/compensation/config_full_opencv_default.json

pipeline_runs._why: The Calibration.py runs this comparison reads, made by reproduce.py before it runs. Every pipeline setting is stated. They use the gray channel, as the runs these results were first made from did; the standard pipeline's channel is merge.

_scale_plot_exclude_why: Left out of fig_scale only: T1's bars are about 30 mm short, which flattens every other curve. Its numbers stay in every table.
_target_plot_exclude_why: Left out of fig_target only: T1 measures the tags 6-14 mm short, which flattens every other technique. Its numbers stay in the tables.

quiver_gains._why: Arrow gains of the quiver plot: the techniques using the in-air calibration (T1, Pinax) have residuals of pixels, those fitted in water of tenths of a pixel, so each group is drawn at its own gain in one figure.

_report_cameras_why: Figures and report tables show the left (reference) camera only, because the stereo results are in its frame. Both cameras are still fitted and scored, and the stereo results (scale bars, WaterComparison tags) use both.

target._why: WaterComparison: ordinary AprilTag 36h11 tags (1-bit border), ids 6-11 in 3 rows x 2 columns, outer black square printed at 145 mm (G. Jones). One stereo pair per distance label (cm) in pairs.csv: 50, 100, 150, 200, 250.

detection._why: The untuned preset, as for the board. CLAHE and contour refinement are kept: they were chosen for this target (the pipeline's cornerSubPix moves its corners by up to 26 px), not by the sweep.

covariance._why: Intrinsic covariance sigma^2 (J^T J)^-1 with the board poses eliminated (calibmethods/covariance.py), for every technique fitted in water; the in-air techniques' intrinsics come from this in-air run, so its covariance is computed on its own frames.
